title: OverSire session digest
description: A short record of the history of one coding agent session. The Status job reads it. Readers: AgentBinder TranscriptReader (Swift), oversire-runner digest (Go) and oversire/scripts/digest.py. All three give the same digest for the cases in fixtures/session-digest (input in fixtures/session-digest/<harness>/<case>.jsonl). Lengths count Unicode code points.

HistoryBudget.description: How much of the history a reader keeps. A missing field takes its default.

earlier.description: The number of earlier turns, before the last ones.

full.description: The number of last turns with the full agent text.

maxChars.description: The maximum length of the agent text of one last turn. The reader keeps the end of the text.

prompt.description: The first 120 characters of the human prompt.

closing.description: The first 700 characters of the last text block of the agent in the turn.

interrupted.description: The developer stopped the turn. Missing means false.

prompt.description: The first 1500 characters of the human prompt.

text.description: The text blocks of the agent, joined with an empty line. Tool input and output are left out.

tools.description: The number of tool calls in the turn.

interrupted.description: The developer stopped the turn. Missing means false.

SessionDigest.description: A turn is a human prompt and the agent output until the next human prompt. The reader skips meta lines, sidechain lines, compaction summaries, tool results and notices (a prompt that starts with '<', but not '<pasted'). A prompt that starts with '[Request interrupted' marks the turn before it. A turn without agent text is left out.

harness.description: The AgentBinder harness, for example claude.

source.description: Where the digest comes from. A reader that does not know a value keeps it.

turns.description: The number of turns in the session.

truncated.description: The reader left out turns or cut the text of a last turn.
